# Taken, at their upstream names: the 31 light scales (`<scale>.css`, each a
# `:root` block of twelve sRGB steps and the same steps in Display P3), and the
# licence. The palette oracle (scripts/palette-oracle.lean) reads the sRGB block.
#
# Left: the dark scales, the alpha scales, black-alpha and white-alpha (no

# another spelling), the README, package.json and its contributor list, and
